# G09b-resume-advertised: An agent that advertises sessionCapabilities.resume is resumed with session/resume (no history replay), then set_mode. Gemini CLI 0.62 does not advertise it (its dispatcher has no resumeSession): this is the generic ACP base path.
# Gemini CLI 0.62 does not advertise session/resume: keep synthesized until an agent that does is recorded.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/G09b-resume-advertised --id G09b --slug resume-advertised --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09b-resume-advertised/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09b-resume-advertised/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G09b-resume-advertised/responders.mjs --var sessionId=<the session id> --timeout 900000 -- --acp --skip-trust
